description: The woman wears a cream opaque floor-length dress with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice and elbow-length cream sleeves. Dark brown and gold geometric woven trim borders the neckline, central bodice panel and sleeve edges. Rust-brown outer panels hang along the sides beneath round gold shoulder clasps. A matching rust-brown and gold sash wraps the waist and has long tasselled ends. A rust-colored gold-bordered wrap rests around the forearms and falls down both sides. Gold dangling earrings and a broad gold cuff are visible. A patterned brown slipper shows below the modest lower skirt opening.
